Definition: Shammah, the name of an Edomite and four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shammah = "astonishment"; 1) son of Reuel, grandson of Esau, and a chief of Edom; 2) the 3rd son of Jesse and a brother of David; 3) son of Agee the Hararite and one of the 30 of David's mighty warriors; 4) the Harodite, one of the 30 of David's mighty warriors; 5) another Hararite, one of the 30 of David's mighty warriors
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
